visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women are standing in a cluttered indoor room with fluorescent lighting and white tiled ceilings. The woman on the right, wearing a white tank top with cherry prints and a red mini skirt, holds out her left forearm to show a large red skin irritation. The other two women, one in a striped baseball jersey and one in a black tank top, look at the arm and point at the mark with expressions of curiosity. (2) The scene cuts to a mall food court setting where two women are looking at a pink smartphone. The woman on the left, wearing a maroon cap and black cardigan, has her mouth wide open and eyes squinted while she repeatedly slaps the other woman's arm with her hand. (3) On an outdoor rooftop terrace with high-rise buildings in the background, the same two women are looking at the phone. The woman on the left is shaking her body while repeatedly hitting the other woman's shoulder with a closed fist in a playful manner. (4) Standing in front of a modern building at night with lit windows, the two women are dressed in school-uniform-style white shirts and grey pleated skirts. They are looking at the phone while the woman on the left pushes and slaps the other woman's arm continuously, moving her body dynamically.
